00003| The :class:`Scheduler` drives a whole pipeline to completion on a *virtual*
00004| clock. There is no real time, no sleeping and no threads: each iteration of the
00005| loop is one virtual tick, and the scheduler decides what happens at that tick by
00006| inspecting the state of every job run.
00007| 
00008| Each tick proceeds in four phases, in this order:
00009| 
00010| 1. **Wake retries.** Any run in ``RETRYING`` whose backoff delay has elapsed is
00011|    returned to ``READY`` and re-queued.
00012| 2. **Complete.** Any ``RUNNING`` run whose finish time has arrived executes its
00013|    action (one attempt). On success it becomes ``SUCCEEDED``; on failure it is
00014|    either sent back to ``RETRYING`` (if its retry policy still permits an
00015|    attempt) or to ``FAILED``. A permanent failure cascades: every task that
00016|    transitively depends on the failed one is marked ``SKIPPED``.
00017| 3. **Unlock.** Any ``PENDING`` run whose dependencies have all ``SUCCEEDED``
00018|    becomes ``READY`` and is pushed onto the ready queue.
00019| 4. **Admit.** While the concurrency limit and resource pools allow, the highest
00020|    priority ready run is dispatched to ``RUNNING``, holding its declared
00021|    resources until it completes.
00022| 
00023| The scheduler narrates every step on an :class:`~taskflow.events.EventBus` so a
00024| :class:`~taskflow.history.History` (or any observer) can reconstruct the run.
00025| """
00026| 
00027| from __future__ import annotations
00028| 
00029| from taskflow.dag import Dag
00030| from taskflow.events import EventBus
00031| from taskflow.model import GraphError, JobContext, JobRun, State
00032| from taskflow.resources import ResourceManager
00033| from taskflow.queue import ReadyQueue
00034| from taskflow.statemachine import IllegalTransition, StateMachine
00035| 
00036| # A generous ceiling on virtual ticks so a mis-configured pipeline cannot spin
00037| # forever. Real pipelines settle in a number of ticks proportional to the graph
00038| # depth; this only ever trips on a pathological configuration.
00039| DEFAULT_MAX_TICKS = 10000

00042| class SchedulerResult:
00043|     """The outcome of a :meth:`Scheduler.run`, queryable by task id.
00044| 
00045|     Bundles the final :class:`~taskflow.model.JobRun` objects together with the
00046|     :class:`~taskflow.history.History` and the resource manager, and offers a
00047|     few convenience queries so tests and the runner do not have to reach into
00048|     the internals.

00051|     def __init__(self, runs, history, bus, resources, ticks):
00052|         self.runs = runs
00053|         self.history = history
00054|         self.bus = bus
00055|         self.resources = resources
00056|         self.ticks = ticks
00057| 
00058|     def state_of(self, task_id):
00059|         """Return the final :class:`~taskflow.model.State` of ``task_id``."""
00060| 
00061|         return self.runs[task_id].state
00062| 
00063|     def attempts_of(self, task_id):

00075| 
00076|         return [tid for tid, run in self.runs.items() if run.state is state]
00077|

00079|         """Return ``True`` if every run ended in ``SUCCEEDED``."""
00080| 
00081|         return all(run.state is State.SUCCEEDED for run in self.runs.values())

00090| class Scheduler:
00091|     """Deterministically execute a pipeline on a virtual clock.
00092| 
00093|     Parameters
00094|     ----------
00095|     pipeline:
00096|         The :class:`~taskflow.model.Pipeline` to run.
00097|     dag:
00098|         The dependency graph. Built from the pipeline when omitted.
00099|     resources:
00100|         A :class:`~taskflow.resources.ResourceManager`. An empty (unconstrained)
00101|         manager is used when omitted.
00102|     concurrency:
00103|         The maximum number of runs allowed in ``RUNNING`` at once. ``None``
00104|         means "no limit beyond what resources impose".

00106|         The :class:`~taskflow.events.EventBus` to narrate on. A fresh bus is
00107|         created when omitted.

00112|     def __init__(

00114|         pipeline,
00115|         dag=None,
00116|         resources=None,
00117|         concurrency=None,
00118|         bus=None,

00122|         self.dag = dag if dag is not None else Dag.from_pipeline(pipeline)
00123|         self.resources = resources if resources is not None else ResourceManager()
00124|         self.concurrency = concurrency
00125|         self.bus = bus if bus is not None else EventBus()
00126|         self.max_ticks = max_ticks

00128|         self._runs = {}
00129|         self._machines = {}

00132|         self._retrying = {}     # id -> JobRun waiting out a backoff

00135|         for task in pipeline.tasks():
00136|             run = JobRun(task)
00137|             self._runs[task.id] = run
00138|             self._machines[task.id] = StateMachine(run)

00140|     # -- public API -------------------------------------------------------
00141| 
00142|     def run(self):
00143|         """Execute the pipeline to completion and return a :class:`SchedulerResult`.
00144| 
00145|         Rejects a cyclic graph up front (a cycle can never make progress). Then
00146|         it loops the four-phase tick until every run is settled, the loop makes
00147|         no further progress (a resource or dependency deadlock), or the tick
00148|         ceiling is hit.

00151|         self.dag.assert_acyclic()

00153|         self._now = 0

00155|             if self._now > self.max_ticks:
00156|                 break

00160|                 # backoff timer: no future tick can change anything. Stop rather
00161|                 # than spin. Any un-run tasks are left in their current state.

00166|             runs=dict(self._runs),
00167|             history=None,  # attached by the runner if a History is wired in

00169|             resources=self.resources,
00170|             ticks=self._now,
00171|         )

00173|     # -- the tick ---------------------------------------------------------

00175|     def _tick(self):

00180|         progressed = self._complete_running() or progressed

00183|         return progressed
00184| 
00185|     def _wake_retries(self):
00186|         """Return ``RETRYING`` runs whose backoff has elapsed to ``READY``."""

00188|         progressed = False
00189|         for task_id in list(self._retrying.keys()):

00204|             for run in self._running.values()
00205|             if run.finish_at is not None and run.finish_at <= self._now

00208|         due.sort(key=lambda r: (r.finish_at, self.pipeline.task_ids().index(r.id)))

00211|         for run in due:

00216|     def _complete_one(self, run):

00220|         del self._running[run.id]

00224|         error = None

00226|             if task.action is not None:

00230|             error = exc

00279|         for task_id in self.pipeline.task_ids():
